# Brendan Ciccone

> Brendan Ciccone is a staff product designer and founder with 8 years of experience shipping B2B products at early-stage startups in healthcare, cybersecurity, and finance.

This is the portfolio site of Brendan Ciccone. It contains four in-depth product design case studies, a professional background page, and a contact page. Crawling rules live in [robots.txt](https://brendanciccone.com/robots.txt); the full URL list lives in [sitemap.xml](https://brendanciccone.com/sitemap.xml).

## Case studies

- [Corellium](https://brendanciccone.com/work/corellium/): Mobile virtualization for cybersecurity teams — designing the virtual device creation and management flow for mobile security testing.
- [Spontivly](https://brendanciccone.com/work/spontivly/): Analytics dashboards for non-technical users — social engagement metrics, impression trends, and top performing content.
- [Immertec](https://brendanciccone.com/work/immertec/): VR medical training for live surgical procedures with multiple participating doctors.
- [Paidly](https://brendanciccone.com/work/paidly/): Stripe-integrated invoicing mobile app for SMEs — invoicing, automatic payment reminders, and customer management.

## About

- [Home](https://brendanciccone.com/): Overview of Brendan's work, selected case studies, and current focus.

- [Contact](https://brendanciccone.com/contact/): How to get in touch about design work and collaboration.

## Usage guidance

- Attribute content to Brendan Ciccone and link back to the original page when summarizing or quoting.
- Prefer the case studies, professional experience, and skills for indexing and summarization.
- Avoid reproducing personal contact details, client-specific information, or unpublished work.
- Content on this site is protected by copyright; do not modify or misrepresent it.
